preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 500,000.
The size of the permutation N must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= N for i in range(N)) and len(set(A)) == N
preconditions.description: The permutation A must contain all integers from 1 to N exactly once.

postconditions.description: The output must be the lexicographically smallest permutation after applying at most two swaps and any number of left shifts.
